## Geographic location


```{r}
# Geographic coordinates for sampling locations
IMOS_long_lat <- data.frame(Location = c("BAB", "IsK", "IsG"), 
                   Latitude = c(78.658333, 78.320667, 78.128833),
                   Longitude = c(16.675, 15.162667, 14.002833), 
                   Bottom_depth = c(191, 274, 273))

print("Geographic coordinates of sampling locations:")
print(IMOS_long_lat)

# Calculate distances between locations (in km)
library(geosphere)
print("\nDistances between sampling locations (km):")
for(i in 1:nrow(IMOS_long_lat)) {
  for(j in 1:nrow(IMOS_long_lat)) {
    if(i < j) {
      dist_km <- distHaversine(c(IMOS_long_lat$Longitude[i], IMOS_long_lat$Latitude[i]),
                               c(IMOS_long_lat$Longitude[j], IMOS_long_lat$Latitude[j])) / 1000
      cat(paste(IMOS_long_lat$Location[i], "to", IMOS_long_lat$Location[j], ":", 
                round(dist_km, 1), "km\n"))
    }
  }
}
```


### Geographic Map of Sampling Sites

Let's create a map showing where the samples were collected:

```{r}
library(maps)
library(mapdata)

# Create a map of the sampling region (Svalbard)
print("Map of sampling locations")

# Basic map
map_plot <- ggplot() +
  # Add map background (world map)
  borders("world", colour = "gray50", fill = "gray90") +
  # Add sampling points
  geom_point(data = IMOS_long_lat, 
             aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, size = Bottom_depth, colour = Location),
             alpha = 0.8) +
  # Add location labels
  geom_text_repel(data = IMOS_long_lat,
                  aes(x = Longitude, y = Latitude, label = Location),
                  size = 4, fontface = "bold") +
  # Set map boundaries around Svalbard
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(10, 20), ylim = c(77, 79.5)) +
  labs(title = "IMOS Sampling Locations - Svalbard",
       x = "Longitude (°E)", y = "Latitude (°N)",
       size = "Depth (m)", colour = "Location") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"))

print(map_plot)
```
